_about: Skill-level acceptance criteria. 'description' is the human-readable success rule; 'predicates' are the machine-checkable postconditions and MUST stay equal to the postconditions declared for the same skill in config/skills_seed.json (the SkillLibrary is the single source of truth). tests/test_demo_fixtures.py enforces this equality. HTTP 200 alone never counts as success: the final device/page state must satisfy these predicates.

confirm_booking.description: Room A at the requested time is booked (booking_status == confirmed).

set_temperature.description: The WoT thermostat targetTemperature equals the requested target.

set_lighting.description: The WoT lights brightness equals the requested brightness.

verify_readiness.description: Composite readiness is true: booked, projector on, target temperature reached, and lights dimmed.
